product_metadata.title: El Paso Designs Mexican Yoga Blanket | Colorful Falsa Serape | Park Blanket, Yoga Towel, Picnic, Beach Blanket, Patio Blanket, Soft Woven Saddle Blanket, Boho Home Décor (Baby Shower)
features: TRADITIONAL HAND-MADE QUALITY: Carefully crafted by Mexican artisans located in Tlaxcala, Mexico, each tassel is individually hand-tied to produce a high-quality authentic Mexican Yoga Blanket. These blankets are soft, thick, and available in a wide variety of vivid colors.

TRADITIONAL HAND-MADE QUALITY: Carefully crafted by Mexican artisans located in Tlaxcala, Mexico, each tassel is individually hand-tied to produce a high-quality authentic Mexican Yoga Blanket. These blankets are soft, thick, and available in a wide variety of vivid colors.
MEASUREMENTS & MATERIALS: Our authentic Mexican yoga blanket measures approximately 51 x 74 inches and is woven from a blend of soft environmentally friendly recycled fibers.

MULTIPLE USES: Improve your yoga practice with our Falsa blanket for use over your yoga mat as a yoga blanket, yoga bolster, or meditation blanket. This blanket can be used indoors/outdoors and is ideal for the beach, camping, picnics, a twin bedspread, southwestern throw, accent throw, saddle blanket, home decor, car seat covers, or outdoor blanket.
WASHING INSTRUCTIONS: Hand or machine wash in cold water on a gentle cycle. Hang to dry or tumble dry with low heat; Do Not Bleach.

GIFT: The perfect gift for any occasion such as birthdays, holidays, graduations, stocking stuffers, or Christmas. Adults, children, and pets love the blanket evenly for it’s undeniable comfortability.
